want: a short water spray whoosh as a hull leaves the water surface, wet and airy
heard: A very short, close-up, sharp burst of water — like liquid being flicked or sprayed from a small source. Wet, splashy, with a few tiny drippy droplets in the short tail. No real air movement or low-end weight; very small in scale.
sounds_like: Spritzing a water bottle or flicking wet fingers
problems: It's wet but not airy — there's no whoosh or air-pushing quality at all. Scale is tiny (hand-sized spray), not a hull, so it'll sound wrong next to a boat. Also too splattery/drippy and clicky at the front, lacking the smooth sweep-out of a vessel leaving the water.
